elements.label: Table column-header hover state (grey fill and kebab menu icon) appearing and clearing as the cursor passes

pattern.description: The cursor sweeps right across the list's column header. The header row briefly shows its hover state (grey fill and a kebab menu icon), then the cursor passes the '+' add-column button and continues right, so the hover state clears.
pattern.why_premium: There is little premium craft here: it is incidental hover feedback in a raw screen recording, timed with 'create a new view'. Its only value is as a reference for keeping the UI's native hover states, which make a demo feel live rather than staged.

build_hint.gsap: Move the cursor along a path with gsap.to('.cursor', {x: ..., duration: 0.4, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); toggle the header hover with tl.set('.col-header', {backgroundColor: '#f1f2f4'}).set('.kebab', {autoAlpha: 1}, '<') when the cursor enters, then reverse with set() when it leaves.
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate the cursor x over frames. Derive hover = cursorX in [headerLeft, headerRight], then render the header background and kebab icon conditionally (instant state change, no easing).

notes: Very subtle event (b01 changed_share 0.0001). The end_marked/end_clean images show a later state: the view is named 'Sales', 'Group by' is active, a 'Group by' side panel is open and the cursor is on 'Select a field'. That does not match filmstrip frame f3019, which shows only the table header with no cursor. The end frame may be mis-sampled; worth a human look. The moving cursor has no candidate box and is not listed.
